      "observations": [
        "All 1,404 owned diff lines across all 23 paths were read, including every changed test/helper hunk. CloseWindow and abort leave nsIMsgCompose; JS replaces the close wrapper with window.close. Native docshell unregistration and message-send/editor release move into the destructor, retaining its uninitialized and in-flight temporary-attachment guards. This is cleanup ordering, not evidence of collection or a leak cure.",
        "Successful CompleteGenericSendMessage closes Now/Later windows after awaiting sendMsg and dispatching aftersend; saves remain open. Its catch now logs, unlocks and returns rather than rethrowing. GenericSendMessage then emits compose-prepare-message-completed without an exception detail for that handled inner error. Other preparation errors still reach the outer catch. Accepted code retains the handled-return boundary, adds special abort handling and later waits progress-stop before closing Now/Later/Background.",
        "PromiseMsgOutgoingListener now stores the request at onSendStart and settles at onSendStop after awaiting sendDeliveryCallback. nsMsgSendUnsent deliberately returns before settlement; if delivery processing rejects, later settlement statements are not reached. Constructor/onSendStart JSDoc still claims start-time resolution in the owned source; accepted constructor wording is corrected, while the onSendStart sentence remains inaccurate.",
        "The owned _smtpRequest field now stores outgoingListener.requestPromise, but abort still tests _smtpRequest?.value before invoking cancel. The constructed plain Promise has no value field assigned by this scope. This field therefore does not expose the request to that abort branch. Accepted code instead stores the listener and forwards or queues cancellation through its cancel method. These are static source phases, without a reproduced cancellation failure or cure.",
        "Awaited delivery/FCC methods do not by themselves establish sent-copy completion: _mimeDoFcc invokes startCopyOperation without awaiting a terminal copy callback, and _doFcc2 schedules its notification/cleanup by timeout. SmtpServer separately returns a promise resolved on ondone and delegates errors to its listener without rejection; MessageSend ignores that server return and awaits the listener's promise. No universal settled/error-completion guarantee is inferred.",
        "The native OnStopSending retained after review actually calls GetFcc before comparing fieldsFCC to nocopy://, so the abandoned empty-local/dead-block draft concern is not projected onto this landing. The owned callback reports ComposeProcessDone only for nocopy://; accepted later code also closes progress on failed status. Broader Fcc architecture and send-later rework remain separate.",
        "The editor-presence guard wraps only editor flags/spell-check operations: input, row and pill enable/disable updates still follow. Returning early merely because editor is absent would skip that remaining work. The bad-certificate dialog callback now checks gCurrentIdentity after removing its observer and confirming an exception was added. No editor teardown race or dialog behavior was exercised.",
        "PromiseTestUtils converts the changed URL/copy/request/search/store/send/operation helper rejections from raw statuses into Error(status); affected tests compare error.message with status values. URL/Copy constructors become classes while wrapped notifications remain before settlement. PromiseSendLaterListener adds status/msg to its successful count result, reusing its established success/failure contract rather than inventing a new one.",
        "New PromiseCopySendListener extends PromiseCopyListener but also settles on send-stop/not-performed/security callbacks. Its inherited copy callback and its send callbacks share the same promise; settlement of one callback is not proof that both phases completed. The migrated send-later test queues, checks outbox contents, then expects send failure and remaining unsent state; it drops the old exact failure-code/total/success/error-raised assertions.",
        "The changed STARTTLS failure check catches both the listener rejection and its own Error thrown if the listener unexpectedly fulfills, then only asserts that the caught value is truthy. Its failure check can therefore accept that synthetic unexpected-success error. The exact same chain remains at the fixed revision; this is a static test weakness, not an executed passing result.",
        "Nine in-scope assertion calls have no expected-behavior message: two certificate-telemetry assertions, four migrated send-later state/data assertions, two NoUidl rejection assertions and the password-cancel equal call. The new send-later try/catch encloses its success-path failing assertion as well as the awaited promise; harness assertion-throw behavior is not assumed. Other changed comparisons retain their explicit messages; missing should alone is not classified as a defect.",
        "Certificate tests remove the expectedCert guard, always inspect the override/permanence/telemetry, resend and wait for window closure; the existing 500 ms wait has a local lint exception. IDN tests now await sending and only flag caught failures for valid/ASCII cases. The full primary contains later regression locators only; full review includes 19 actual inline bodies/three code blocks, a corrected initial approval, deferred native-error exposure and send-later work. All reports remain historical.",
        "The bounded native caller forwards CreateAndSendMessage's Promise. Its owned message-file creation path can itself report failure and return null normally, while successful file creation returns _deliverMessage. Normal outer completion therefore is not a stand-alone send-success signal. The new event finding remains conditional on the handled inner path, not a claim that every delivery failure rejects sendMsg.",
        "Complete primary Bug 2030913 original f260fa07e0bf67b01807678c5346536323065d409143a786a257bd1629a2af2a includes current description/comments 0–2, activity and end controls. Later regression entries are metadata locators, not diagnoses or read regression bodies.",
        "Full own D293863 is retained with all 19 actual old/resolved inline bodies and three rendered code blocks. The first acceptance is explicitly corrected to Request Changes. Reviewer separates an empty fieldsFCC comparison from broader Fcc documentation; author ultimately acknowledges lost field access. The actual owned source restores GetFcc before comparison, so the abandoned draft defect is not asserted as landed.",
        "The window.close replacement is agreed in the thread and adopted in source. The Assert.throws idea is not adopted merely because the thread says Done: the author retains a failed-promise test, explicitly reports native error constants still not exposed to JS and defers that to Bug 2033105. Send-later architecture work is deferred to Bug 2032686.",
        "The private author preference to reject Error objects is supported only by the actual changed helper scope; it is not a new global error rule. The owned sendUnsent exception, callback-before-settlement ordering, original abort field mismatch and later cancellable-listener/progress-stop phases stay distinct.",
        "All required contexts are complete, but no historical stack Try or build report was rerun. Nine assertion-message omissions and the STARTTLS synthetic-error acceptance are checked from exact source. No send, cancellation, leak, certificate, UI, test or native-platform result is claimed."
